Agent.reason: Local sequential tool orchestration; not an isolated Claude-style subagent runtime.

Bash.reason: Shell execution is intentionally excluded from the default hardened registry.

Config.reason: Model-driven configuration mutation is intentionally excluded from the default registry.

DataInspect.reason: Bounded stdlib-only structured preview/schema for CSV, TSV, JSON-array, and JSONL data files.

DataTransform.reason: Bounded exact-match filter/column projection ETL into new CSV, TSV, JSON, or JSONL files; source must be read and unchanged; existing outputs are never overwritten.

EnterWorktree.reason: Creates a real linked Git worktree under .git/clawd-worktrees on a new clawd/<name> branch from committed HEAD; explicit approval required.

ExitWorktree.reason: Returns the session to the original workspace while preserving the linked worktree and branch; no deletion is performed.

LSP.reason: Pinned local Pyright runtime with workspace-bounded read-only operations.

ListMcpResourcesTool.reason: Read-only resources from operator-configured local stdio MCP servers via isolated mcp 2.2.0 runtime.

ListMcpToolsTool.reason: Lists only operator-authorized tools from configured local stdio MCP servers; server annotations are hints only.

MCP.reason: Local stdio MCP tool execution requires operator policy, fresh advertisement, pinned name/description/input/output contract, schema-valid input, and explicit approval for mutating or open-world tools.

NotebookEdit.reason: Structural Jupyter .ipynb cell replace/insert/delete with read-before-write, workspace/path protections, and no notebook execution.

ReadMcpResourceTool.reason: Reads only resource URIs previously advertised by the same configured MCP server in the current Clawd session.

TeamCreate.reason: Lightweight team metadata only; does not spawn or schedule subagents. Metadata writes use workspace, sensitive-path, and protected-history permission checks.

TeamDelete.reason: Deletes only the current team metadata file after workspace, sensitive-path, and protected-history permission checks.

authentication_recovery.reason: REPL classifies provider authentication failures without vendor-SDK coupling, surfaces sanitized recovery guidance, prevents direct-response auth failures from causing a second provider attempt, and supports explicit in-session provider reconfiguration that rebinds runtime/session/command-context state without automatically retrying the failed request.

context_engine.reason: Agent-loop system context includes bounded workspace metadata, a deterministic names-only project map with source/test representation, README and entry-file excerpts, Git context, hierarchical CLAUDE.md instructions, and persistent memory; project-map traversal is workspace-bound, does not follow symlinks, and omits sensitive-looking files.

hook_runtime.reason: Generic user-defined hook execution is intentionally excluded; current security and lifecycle policies use dedicated fail-closed chokepoints. Revisit only for a concrete approved use case.

permission_policy_configuration.reason: Fail-closed operator policy from ~/.clawd/operator-permissions.json may grant bounded documentation and additional-root authority; repository .clawd/permissions.json may only add tool denials or force allow_docs off and cannot expand operator authority.

python_plugin_runtime.reason: Manifest-only local Python plugin discovery with exact-hash operator activation; discovery never imports or executes plugin Python.

custom_commands_tools.reason: Exact-hash active Python plugins may register collision-checked COMMANDS and permission-enforced TOOLS through the existing Clawd registries; generic executable hooks remain excluded.

chinese_provider_ecosystem.reason: DeepSeek, Alibaba Qwen, Zhipu GLM, and MiniMax are built-in selectable providers with dedicated defaults, model catalogs, API-key environment variables, and provider-class coverage; additional vendors use the trusted provider-extension path.

data_engineering_runtime.reason: Bounded stdlib-only inspect and deterministic exact-match/project/load workflow for CSV, TSV, JSON-array, and JSONL datasets; no arbitrary expressions or in-place overwrite.

developer_quality_tooling.reason: Locked uv developer workflow with Python 3.12 pin, full pytest suite, correctness-focused Ruff gate, and explicit gradual Mypy baseline; pip .[dev] compatibility is retained.

enterprise_workflow_extensions.reason: Exact-hash operator-approved Python plugins may declare declarative WORKFLOWS that compile to plugin PromptCommands with kind=workflow, mandatory non-empty explicit tool allowlists, collision checks, and existing Clawd tool permissions. Workflows are interactive/session-scoped; no background daemon or generic executable hook runtime is enabled.

provider_extensions.reason: Exact-hash active Python plugins may register collision-checked BaseProvider subclasses. Remote providers remain credential-gated; credentialless providers must be local-only with loopback/localhost endpoints.

sanitized_runtime_instrumentation.reason: Sanitized tool/skill/change/provider/usage ledgers are best-effort and local; /doctor reports ledger health plus recent sanitized runtime errors without provider/network calls.

subagent_runtime.reason: No isolated child LLM loop, context, session, or worker runtime exists; Agent is same-context sequential tool dispatch and TeamCreate stores metadata only.
